messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-15] standup/cinder/2025-09-15: Reminder that the catalog service depends on image-resizer.
- [2025-03-28] standup/cinder/2025-03-28: The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer: Handover: as of today image-resizer moves from Dune to Cinder. Farah Haddad walked Yuki through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer: From today the pager for image-resizer rings the Boreal team, not Cinder. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.
- [2026-01-20] handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer: From today the pager for the resizer rings team Dune, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-03-20] standup/dune/2026-03-20: Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2026-03-18] standup/boreal/2026-03-18: Reminder that the product catalog depends on the resizer.
- [2026-04-29] standup/ember/2026-04-29: Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-01] standup/cinder/2025-04-01: We agreed today that the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. The reason is that the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2025-05-28] standup/dune/2025-05-28: Reminder: the scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03-2: For newcomers: the deploy window for the job scheduler is still on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-08-20] standup/cinder/2025-08-20: Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical. Cinder noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-04-14] standup/ember/2025-04-14: Auth-gateway deploy window: on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2: The catalog deploy window: on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-09-18] standup/dune/2025-09-18: The Dune team saw that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-22] standup/boreal/2025-04-22: Per the change policy, the event-bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-05] standup/dune/2025-03-05: Reporting deploy window: on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-13] standup/boreal/2026-03-13: Deploy freeze for the ledger: 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 (the fiscal year close).
- [2025-09-26] standup/atlas/2025-09-26: For newcomers: the deploy window for the ledger service is still on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Webhooks deploy window: on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-12] standup/boreal/2025-11-12: The catalog service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The old slot (Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.

Question: When can image-resizer be deployed?
